units.source_text: [\[2\]](#part1330.html#w2) 当时的中央官厅称为太政官。

en.t: At that time, the central government office was called the Daijokan.

units.source_text: 左大臣为太政官之长官，右大臣次之。

en.t: The Minister of the Left was the head of the Daijokan, and the Minister of the Right ranked next.

units.source_text: 太政大臣在左右大臣之上，为朝廷最高官。

en.t: The Chancellor stood above the Ministers of the Left and Right and was the highest official at court.

units.source_text: 左右大臣之下有大纳言、中纳言、宰相（即参议）。

en.t: Below the Ministers of the Left and Right were the Major Counselors, Middle Counselors, and councilors, also called sangi.

units.source_text: 太政官下设少纳言局、左弁官局、右弁官局。

en.t: Under the Daijokan were the Lesser Counselor Office, the Left Controller Office, and the Right Controller Office.

units.source_text: 少纳言局的官员有少纳言三人，外记次之，外记有左右大少各一人。

en.t: The Lesser Counselor Office had three lesser counselors; next came the secretaries, with one senior and one junior secretary on both the left and the right.

units.source_text: 弁官有左右大中少弁各一人。

en.t: Among the controllers, there was one senior, middle, and junior controller each for the left and the right.

units.source_text: 左弁官局统辖中务、式部、治部、民部四省；右弁官局统辖兵部、刑部、大藏、宫内四省。

en.t: The Left Controller Office supervised the four ministries of Central Affairs, Ceremonial, Civil Administration, and Popular Affairs; the Right Controller Office supervised the four ministries of Military Affairs, Justice, the Treasury, and the Imperial Household.
Together they were known as the Eight Ministries.

units.source_text: 省下面是各职和各寮，均属省管。

en.t: Below the ministries were various offices and bureaus, all under ministerial control.

units.source_text: 省的长官称卿，次官称大辅、少辅，三等官称大丞、少丞。

en.t: The head of a ministry was called a kyo; the deputy officials were called senior assistant and junior assistant, and the third-rank officials were called senior secretary and junior secretary.

units.source_text: 职的长官称大夫，次官称亮，三等官称大进、少进。

en.t: The head of an office was called a daibu; the deputy was called a suke, and the third-rank officials were called senior recorder and junior recorder.

units.source_text: 寮的长官称头，次官称助，三等官称大允、少允。

en.t: The head of a bureau was called a kami; the deputy was called a suke, and the third-rank officials were called senior jo and junior jo.
